verdict.rationale: xAI docs describe a built-in delegation feature (Grok Bot: 'hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer') plus connectors letting Grok access email/files/calendar/tools, matching the story. However hands-on community testing reports the opposite experience — 'had real trouble with agentic tool calling - the model felt like it hadn't been trained to think of tool calling as one of its primary modalities' — directly contradicting the vendor's agentic-delegation claims. Missing for 10: independent verification that Grok Bot actually completes delegated multi-step tasks reliably, and resolution of the tool-calling reliability gap noted by users.
